snippet.title: Circle Empires 2 - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Circle Empires 2 is OUT NOW! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3093020/Circle_Empires_2/

CIRCLE EMPIRES returns! Expand your empire, circle by circle, in this fast-paced follow-up to the hit RTS. Gather resources, build armies, and defeat bosses (or your friends) in a world that changes with every game. With unique units and biomes, it's an addictive battle of wits and tactics.

Stay up to date with Circle Empires 2 and Iceberg Interactive:
